title: Community
html:
Community

EOMasters provides not only Software and Knowlede but also a place for the EO Community. Meet here equally minded people, who work in the same domain and have the same interest and struggle with similar problems or read about EO realted topics in the blog and visit the archive of the newsletter.

EOMasters Groups

The groups are the places where you can discuss discuss about interesting topics, like forest monitoring, land classification, and water constituents detection. If you have questions regarding certain topics, you can probably find someone who can help you.
